prerequisites: Solid background in various electronic devices from "Tecnología eléctrica" and "Tecnología electrónica" courses

learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and design basic amplification circuits with operational amplifiers, as well as select the appropriate operational amplifier for a given application.
Analyze and design linear power supplies.
Understand the general principles of the most important types of sensors and their characteristics, and select an appropriate sensor for elementary applications.
Select, analyze, and, in some cases, design basic signal conditioning circuits.
Simulate analog electronic circuits using common software tools.

syllabus_topics: Basic parameters of analog and instrumental systems
Characteristics of the real operational amplifier: input, output, and transfer
Real operational amplifier as a circuit element: DC and AC effects
Sensors and conditioning circuits for sensors
Non-signal generating sensors: resistive, capacitive, and inductive
Signal generating sensors: thermocouples, piezoelectrics, optoelectronics, Hall effect
teaching_methods: Virtual Campus resources (PowerPoint presentations, solved problems, complementary material)

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment (Practical block) based on attendance and performance in obtaining practical results

assessment_rules: For the ordinary assessment, the theoretical block grade (Teoría) is calculated as (0.25 * Partial Exam) + (0.75 * Final Exam 1). The final course grade (Final) is calculated as ((5 * Teoría) + Practical Block Grade) / 6. No minimum grade is required for individual components. The practical block grade is retained for all calls within the same academic year. For extraordinary assessment, the final grade is calculated as ((5 * Final Exam 2) + Practical Block Grade) / 6. For differentiated assessment, the final grade is calculated as ((5 * Final Exam) + Practical Exam in laboratory) / 6.
